question: To what kind of person is something said to be given, given the conditions stated?
premises: Something is designated as to be given.
The recipient is one endowed with all states.
The recipient is also one of resolved mind.
inference: What is to be given is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: The thing to be given is not named in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
